features.name: Pre-commit ESLint and Stylelint
features.description: Add JavaScript/TypeScript and CSS lint checks to the repository and the staged-file commit workflow.

checklist.action: Configure ESLint and Stylelint with repository-compatible rules and passing full-repository lint scripts.
checklist.coverage_reason: Tool configuration has no standalone logic; the full-repository lint command checks the configuration against real files.

verifyEvidence.stderr:
$ pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:css
$ eslint src tests scripts .agent-harness/scripts electron.vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
$ stylelint 'src/**/*.css'

checklist.action: Run lint checks after formatting in pre-commit, document usage, and verify staged lint failures block the hook.
checklist.coverage_reason: This is Git hook integration and documentation; the smoke test exercises the real hook with an isolated index.
